required_consumer_behavior: Request causal evidence only through authenticated tenant/purpose context and preserve API-owned node/edge meanings.
Render why, what changes it, event/receipt/trace links and authoritative source readback without treating trace or provider acknowledgement as truth.
Reject cross-tenant, cyclic, missing-node and unconfirmed-finality graphs.
Return exact UI navigation/readback adoption evidence through a versioned handoff.
known_limitations: No durable universal evidence retrieval route exists.
